algorithm: CA-BOSS v4.54 bootstrap-stable W2 distribution-geometry rescue

v454_bootstrap_wasserstein_geometry.interpretation: W2 quantile geometry adds distribution-shape information absent from the KS-only v4.53 score while retaining the same cross-fit null and whole-world stability guards

method_contract.state_source: rank-three assay-local ICA fit only to held-out background features
method_contract.contexts: full fit plus two disjoint background-feature folds
method_contract.distribution_cost: sign-invariant empirical two-Wasserstein quantile distance over 99 quantiles from 0.01 through 0.99
method_contract.pair_normalization: divide each rank-three assay-pair cost matrix by its median positive cost
method_contract.global_registration: exact multi-assay rank-three permutation synchronization independently in every context
method_contract.score: product of four directional training-fold empirical-CDF percentiles
method_contract.reciprocity_rule: strict unique mutual nearest assay pair in every nested fold
method_contract.nested_score: minimum endpoint-competition margin over four leave-one-source-block calibration folds
method_contract.null_threshold: maximum corresponding margin among other-block mutual-neighbour null pairs
method_contract.bootstrap_unit: whole training world sampled with replacement within source block
method_contract.conflict_handling: merge connected assay pairs into one unexpanded ambiguity hyperedge
method_contract.claim_scope: shared-state equivalence only; never within-assay direct structure, exact cross-assay feature identity, or direction

numerical_reproducibility_audit.problem: machine-precision ordering of theoretically tied empirical-rank features changed four borderline bootstrap frequencies after a TSV round trip
numerical_reproducibility_audit.resolution: quantize the four model features to 12 decimal places before empirical ranking
numerical_reproducibility_audit.conservative_choice: the seven nominal proposals below 0.80 after deterministic quantization remain abstentions

random_panel_diagnostics.random40_seed454000: unquantized W2 global mirror selected 7 true and 0 false additions
random_panel_diagnostics.disjoint_random40_seed454001: unquantized W2 global mirror selected 4 true and 1 false addition; the small-panel null envelope was insufficient
random_panel_diagnostics.all103_role: the five leave-one-block-out calibrations use the complete existing cache to stabilize the empirical null; this is retrospective development, not fresh validation

published_method_inspiration.unpaired_multi_domain_causal_representat: Sturma, Squires, Drton, and Uhler (NeurIPS 2023), Unpaired Multi-Domain Causal Representation Learning, DOI 10.52202/075280-1496
published_method_inspiration.mmd_ma: Liu, Huang, Singh, Vert, and Noble (WABI 2019), Jointly Embedding Multiple Single-Cell Omics Measurements, DOI 10.4230/LIPIcs.WABI.2019.10
published_method_inspiration.scot: Demetci, Santorella, Sandstede, Noble, and Singh (Journal of Computational Biology 2022), SCOT: Single-Cell Multi-Omics Alignment with Optimal Transport, DOI 10.1089/cmb.2021.0446
published_method_inspiration.permutation_synchronization: Pachauri, Kondor, and Singh (NeurIPS 2013), Solving the Multi-way Matching Problem by Permutation Synchronization
published_method_inspiration.stability_selection: Meinshausen and Buehlmann (JRSS B 2010), Stability Selection, DOI 10.1111/j.1467-9868.2010.00740.x
published_method_inspiration.relationship: V4.54 borrows distribution matching and global registration ideas but deliberately does not construct cross-assay cell couplings. No publication contributes data, correspondence, modality identity, feature identity, or biological priors.

limitations.interpretation: V4.54 is the strongest conservative cached-world checkpoint, but all 103 worlds informed method development. Its 1.0 retrospective precision does not establish out-of-sample completeness or identify direct cross-assay effects from disjoint cells.
